name: painted concrete floor
description: Cold concrete with a faded yellow parking line.  The lines go on in every direction, marking bays for cars that were never here.

name: puddle
description: A shallow pool of cold water that has collected in a dip in the concrete.  It smells of rust and oil.

name: pipe-lined wall
description: A concrete wall crowded with rusted pipes.  Some of them drip.  Some of them are warm.  None of them seem to go anywhere.
